tasks.title: Task Assignment & Progress Tracking
tasks.desc: Task log, resolution deadlines, lead handlers/participants, task commentary, and Excel reporting.

common.hiddenTooltip: Only the creator and administrators can see this task

dateInput.outOfRangeDay: This date is outside the allowed range
dateInput.invalidDate: The date {date} does not exist. Please re-enter in day/month/year format, e.g. 25/12/2026.
dateInput.incompleteDate: Date is incomplete. Please enter the full day, month, and year in dd/mm/yyyy format.

filter.dateRangeError: "From date" ({from}) is after "To date" ({to}). Please select a valid date range.

taskList.title: Task List
taskList.subtitle: Tasks you have assigned or are participating in. Click on a task to view details.
taskList.emptyFiltered: No tasks match the current filters.
taskList.emptyFilteredHint: Try changing the filter criteria, or click "Clear filters" to view all tasks.
taskList.emptyAllHint: Click "Add new task" to assign the first task.
taskList.unapprovedNotice: Approval for task "{title}" has been revoked. The task is now Awaiting Approval.
taskList.updatedNotice: Changes to task "{title}" have been saved.
taskList.confirmDeleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete task "{title}"? All attachments, evidence files, and comments will be permanently removed. This action cannot be undone.
taskList.confirmUnapproveMessage: Revoke approval for task "{title}"? The task will return to Awaiting Approval status. It can be re-approved later.

actions.viewOnly: You can only view this task

taskForm.placeholderRequirement: Describe expected results, documents to submit...
taskForm.visibilityHint: Uncheck to hide the task: only the creator and administrators will be able to see it.
taskForm.hostHint: Person authorized to handle the task
taskForm.donViHint: Select multiple departments; users with department-based access will see this task
taskForm.roleExclusiveHint: Each person can hold only one role per task. A person selected for one role will not appear in the list for another role.
taskForm.lockedReason: The task is in "{status}" status or you are not the creator/lead handler, so it cannot be edited. Please close the form and reload the list.
taskForm.validationCount: {count} field(s) are invalid. Please correct the errors highlighted in red below, then click Save.
taskForm.serverValidation: The server rejected some fields. Please correct the errors highlighted in red below, then click Save.
taskForm.errCreatedDatePast: Created date cannot be in the past. Please select today or a future date.
taskForm.errDueDateBeforeCreated: Due date is before the created date. Please select a due date on or after the created date.
taskForm.errDueDatePast: The due date is in the past, so the task will be locked immediately after saving. Please select a due date from today onwards.
taskForm.errHost: Please select a lead handler for the task.
taskForm.errDirectors: Please select at least one supervisor to monitor progress.
taskForm.errParticipants: Please select at least one participating staff member.
taskForm.errRoleOverlap: A staff member holds two roles. Each person can hold only one role per task — please remove them from one role.

statusNotice.CHO_XU_LY: The assignees have not opened this task yet.
statusNotice.DANG_XU_LY: In progress. When finished, the lead handler or participating staff should submit a comment with evidence files to move the task to Awaiting Approval.
statusNotice.CHO_DUYET: Evidence files have been submitted. Waiting for the creator, lead handler, or supervisor to approve.
statusNotice.HOAN_THANH: The task has been approved as completed.
statusNotice.frozen: The task expired without evidence files and has been locked: no comments, no evidence submission, and no edits allowed. If the task still needs to be done, ask the creator to assign a new task.

taskDetail.approvedNotice: Task has been approved as completed.
taskDetail.unapprovedNotice: Approval has been revoked. The task is now Awaiting Approval.
taskDetail.deletedFileNotice: File "{fileName}" has been deleted. The comment containing the file is preserved.
taskDetail.confirmApproveMessage: Confirm that the task is completed? After approval, assignees cannot add or delete evidence files unless approval is revoked.
taskDetail.confirmUnapproveMessage: Revoking approval will return the task to Awaiting Approval so assignees can add more evidence. It can be re-approved later.
taskDetail.confirmDeleteFileMessage: Delete file "{fileName}"? The comment containing the file will be preserved. This action cannot be undone.

comments.heading: Comments ({count})
comments.emptyCommentsHint: When finished, click "Add Comment" to submit results with files.
comments.placeholderWithAttach: Report progress, or describe results and attach evidence files below...
comments.noAttachApproved: The task has been approved, so no more evidence files can be attached. To add more, ask someone with approval authority to revoke the approval first.
comments.noAttachRole: Only the lead handler and participating staff can attach evidence files.
comments.willChangeToPending: Submitting a comment with evidence files will move the task to Awaiting Approval.
comments.immutableWarning: Submitted comments cannot be edited or deleted.
comments.emptyError: Comment is empty. Please enter content before submitting.
comments.emptyErrorWithAttach: Comment is empty. Please enter content or attach evidence files before submitting.
comments.sentWithFilesChangedNotice: Comment submitted with {count} evidence file(s). Task moved to Awaiting Approval.
comments.lockedFrozen: The task is locked, so no more comments can be added.
comments.lockedNoRole: You are not involved in this task, so you can only view it without adding comments.
comments.lockedGeneric: You cannot add comments at this time. Please reload the page to see the latest status.

approval.waitingFrozen: The task expired without evidence files and has been locked. Approval is not possible.
approval.waitingEvidence: The Approve button will appear when the lead handler or participating staff submit a comment with evidence files.
approval.readyToApprove: Evidence files are available. Please review the comments with files above before approving.
approval.alreadyApproved: Approved at {time}{by}. Revoking will return the task to Awaiting Approval.

attachments.deleteFile: Delete this file (the comment will be preserved)

employees.noResults: No matching staff found. Try a different keyword or shorten your search.
employees.selectedCount: {count} staff selected. Click a name to deselect.

filePicker.tooLarge: File "{fileName}" is {size}, exceeding the limit. Please select a file under {max} MB or compress it first.
